summary: Residents looking at the new branch drawing can see how an earlier flood changed the building itself.
realLife: After basement equipment was destroyed at the South End branch, the preliminary design reported in June 2024 omitted a basement and raised the building above the ground.
inGame: needs: flood damage and design stage.

turns.pulledBy: The raised floor remains in the next design.
turns.what: Staff ask the architect to show the route up from the sidewalk.
turns.writesBack: The entrance review uses the revised elevation.

turns.pulledBy: A later drawing changes the floor elevation.
turns.what: Trustees ask where the vulnerable equipment will go.
turns.writesBack: The design record identifies the revised flood protection.
